architecture.one_pass_only: C4 v2 is a one-pass pipeline. Iterative retrieval is OUTSIDE PRIMARY C4.
pipeline: BM25 + BGE CANDIDATE RETRIEVAL (P2 RRF, frozen)
architecture.runtime_purity: No oracle metadata may enter runtime. _oracle_metadata, proof_edges, required_evidence_ids, answer_node, family, entity_regime, and evaluator canonical entity are evaluator-only.

C4_1.description: C4-0 + subject-preserving information state + frozen improved follow-up query formulation

C4_3.description: C4-2 + I3 identity-record resolution + canonicalized state update

C4_4.description: C4-3 + deterministic S2c structure+relation selection + deterministic packet ordering
C4_4.determinism_guarantee: Same task + same candidate pool + same identity + same config always produces same selected evidence + same order + same packet hash
C4_4.deterministic_fallback: if identity_status in {EXACT, RESOLVED}: selector = S2c; else: selector = S0

C4_5.description: same real query/retrieval/identity candidate pool + oracle selector

C4_6.constraint: may bypass retrieval because it is the reader/evidence ceiling

determinism_requirements.pass_criterion: 120/120 identical packet hashes across all runs
determinism_requirements.rule: Every intermediate collection entering S2c must have a canonical ordering, and every ranking must define a total order.
tie_break_policy: 1. selector score descending (quantized to 12 decimal places)
2. evidence role priority ascending (identity < direct/link < bridge < intermediate < current/value/fact < support < distractor)

evaluator_provenance.fail_closed: If source hash does not match manifest, FAIL CLOSED. Do not silently continue.
evaluator_provenance.rule: Every evaluator output must declare its exact input via cryptographic hash binding.
evaluator_provenance.would_have_caught: Two different C4-4 raw files sharing byte-identical evaluator-v2 outputs

fail_closed_runner.valid_run_status: VALID_RUN=true only if every prerequisite passed

goal: Determine whether the independently qualified query, retrieval, identity-resolution, and structural-selection mechanisms compose into a materially better end-to-end HRM memory pipeline without oracle information at runtime, with deterministic reproducibility and cryptographic provenance.

iterative_retrieval_status.may_reconnect_when: Runtime bridge predictor shows positive utility in controlled experiments
iterative_retrieval_status.reason: Oracle bridge strongly improves evidence acquisition, but runtime bridge inference failed qualification. Therefore second pass is withheld from primary C4.

membership_vs_ordering.separation: Membership selection (which records survive) and packet ordering (in what sequence HRM receives them) are distinct stages.

quality.note: Binary correctness stored separately. Never overload quality with accuracy.

packet_hashing.purpose: Clear boundaries for debugging: retrieval changed? membership changed? ordering changed? prompt changed?

packet_ordering_policy.note: This is NOT claimed to be optimal. It is explicit, versioned, testable, and deterministic. Later, ordering can become a separate ablation.

pre_hrm_freeze.architecture: PRE-HRM FREEZE -> immutable packets -> HRM generation
pre_hrm_freeze.purpose: If HRM results change later, you can prove whether the input changed.
pre_hrm_freeze.rule: HRM stage consumes frozen packets. It does not rerun retrieval or selection internally.

primary_question: Do the independently qualified mechanisms compose into a useful, non-oracle RETRIEVE action, reproducibly?

promotion_gates.D1_determinism: 0 packet differences across repeated processes. PASS required.
promotion_gates.D2_provenance: Every evaluator artifact cryptographically references its exact raw source. PASS required.
promotion_gates.D3_metric_correctness: Golden tests verify all quality and gap formulas. PASS required.
promotion_gates.D4_mechanism_gain: On untouched evaluation: Q(C4_4) - Q(C4_0) > 0 with predeclared statistical threshold.
promotion_gates.D5_no_family_regression: Require family-level reporting. No catastrophic collapse in any important family.
promotion_gates.D6_canonical_identity_safety: False canonical resolution = 0 or strict predeclared threshold.
promotion_gates.D7_artifact_integrity: Every file in run manifest matches its hash.
promotion_gates.D8_clean_release: All tests pass, clean git tree, expected commit, expected protocol hash, expected dependencies.

supersedes_reason: v1 had nondeterministic S2c selector due to set iteration; v2 fixes determinism, provenance, and metric formulas
